title: Eclipse Over Ruins
description: A lone figure in a flowing blue robe stands in the center of a dark, decaying gothic ruin, one arm raised toward the sky. A sequence of five glowing red and orange solar eclipses dominates the black sky above the crumbling stone arches and broken pillars.
prompt: A solitary robed figure in deep blue stands inside a ruined gothic temple with crumbling stone arches and broken pillars, one arm raised toward the heavens.
